id: In the Battle Palace, Pokémon are required to think by themselves.
en: In the Battle Palace, Pokémon are required to think by themselves.
it: Nel Palazzo Lotta, i Pokémon devono pensare da soli.

id: Unlike in the wild, Pokémon that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
en: Unlike in the wild, Pokémon that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
it: A differenza di quelli selvatici, i Pokémon che vivono con le persone si comportano in modo diverso a seconda della loro natura.

id: Depending on its nature, a Pokémon may prefer to attack no matter what.
en: Depending on its nature, a Pokémon may prefer to attack no matter what.
it: A seconda della natura, un Pokémon potrebbe preferire attaccare a ogni costo.

id: Another Pokémon may prefer to protect itself from harm.
en: Another Pokémon may prefer to protect itself from harm.
it: Un altro Pokémon potrebbe preferire proteggersi dai danni.

id: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
it: Un altro ancora potrebbe divertirsi a infastidire o confondere gli avversari.

id: A Pokémon's nature determines which moves it is good at using, and which moves it has trouble using.
en: A Pokémon's nature determines which moves it is good at using, and which moves it has trouble using.
it: La natura di un Pokémon determina quali mosse sa usare bene e quali invece usa con difficoltà.

id: There are offensive moves that deal direct damage on the foe.
en: There are offensive moves that deal direct damage on the foe.
it: Ci sono mosse offensive che infliggono danni diretti all'avversario.

id: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
it: Ci sono mosse difensive, usate per prepararsi agli attacchi nemici o per recuperare PS e così via.

id: And there are other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foe with status problems including poison and paralysis.
en: And there are other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foe with status problems including poison and paralysis.
it: E ci sono altre mosse un po' strane che possono indebolire l'avversario con problemi di stato come avvelenamento e paralisi.

id: Pokémon will consider using moves in these three categories.
en: Pokémon will consider using moves in these three categories.
it: I Pokémon valuteranno l'uso di mosse di queste tre categorie.

id: When not taking commands from its Trainer, a Pokémon may be unable to effectively use certain kinds of moves.
en: When not taking commands from its Trainer, a Pokémon may be unable to effectively use certain kinds of moves.
it: Quando non riceve ordini dal suo Allenatore, un Pokémon potrebbe non riuscire a usare efficacemente certi tipi di mosse.

id: A Pokémon is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
en: A Pokémon is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
it: Un Pokémon non è bravo a usare le mosse che non gli piacciono.

id: If a Pokémon only knows moves that don't conform to its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
en: If a Pokémon only knows moves that don't conform to its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
it: Se un Pokémon conosce solo mosse che non si addicono alla sua natura, spesso non riuscirà a esprimere il suo potenziale.

id: Depending on its nature, a Pokémon may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
en: Depending on its nature, a Pokémon may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
it: A seconda della natura, un Pokémon in difficoltà potrebbe iniziare a usare mosse che non si addicono alla sua natura.

id: If a Pokémon begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
en: If a Pokémon begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
it: Se un Pokémon inizia a comportarsi in modo strano quando è alle strette, osservalo con attenzione.

id: There is no battle recorded.
en: There is no battle recorded.
it: Non è stata registrata nessuna lotta.

id: \bWelcome to the Battle Palace.
en: \bWelcome to the Battle Palace.
it: \bBenvenuto al Palazzo Lotta.

en: \bWould you like to participate in a single battle?

id: \bDo you want to take the Level 50 challenge, or the Open Level challenge?
en: \bDo you want to take the Level 50 challenge, or the Open Level challenge?

id: \bSorry, you can't participate. You need three different Pokémon to enter.
en: \bSorry, you can't participate.  You need three different Pokémon to enter.
it: \bMi spiace, non puoi partecipare.  Per iscriverti servono tre Pokémon diversi.

id: \bThey must be of a different species and hold different items.
en: \bThey must be of a different species and hold different items.
it: \bDevono essere di specie diverse e tenere strumenti diversi.

id: \bCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
en: \bCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
it: \bAlcune specie esotiche, così come le uova, non sono ammesse.

id: \bPlease choose the three Pokémon that will enter.
en: \bPlease choose the three Pokémon that will enter.
it: \bScegli i tre Pokémon che parteciperanno.

en: \bPlease come this way.

en: \bCome back another time.

id: \bYou have no room for it. At least you won, though.
en: \bYou have no room for it.  At least you won, though.
it: \bNon hai spazio per tenerlo.  Almeno hai vinto, però.
